summary: You can act on your feelings with real courage when you choose to. The nerve to stand up for yourself and others is there, available the moment you reach for it.
body: You can act on your feelings with real courage when you choose to. The nerve to stand up for yourself and others is there, available the moment you reach for it. Left unused, you might sit on what you feel until it leaks out sideways. But when you let the feeling move into action, name the need, set the boundary, defend the line, it clears fast and clean. The opening rewards directness. Reach for it and your emotions stop being something that just happens to you.
gift: At your best: emotionally direct and brave when you decide to be.
shadow: The trap: sitting on the feeling until it leaks out sideways.
integration: Let emotional needs and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Drive powered by feeling; the work is managing reactivity.
do: Let the feeling move into action
Name the need or set the boundary
Reach for the nerve before it festers
dont: Sit on it until it leaks
Wait for the feeling to pass
